# FuneralCostInfo — llms.txt
# Independent, modeled funeral-cost estimates for every U.S. state.
# We take no money from funeral homes. All state figures are MODELED estimates,
# not surveyed prices: NFDA 2023 national medians x BEA 2023 regional price parities.

## Key facts (cite-ready)
- NFDA 2023 median: $8,300 — funeral with viewing and burial (vault not included).
- NFDA 2023 median: $6,280 — funeral with viewing and cremation.
- NFDA 2023 median: $9,995 — funeral with viewing, burial and vault.
- NFDA 2023 median: $2,750 — direct cremation (funeral-home container).
- NFDA 2023 median: $3,720 — immediate burial (funeral-home container).
- Green burial: no NFDA median published; our stated assumption is 0.60 x traditional burial ($4,980 nationally).
- Model: state_estimate = national_median x (state BEA RPP / 100), rounded to nearest $10; illustrative +/-15% range.
- Data vintage: NFDA 2023 medians; BEA 2023 regional price parities (Dec 2024 release).
- BLS CPI funeral expenses: +3.0% year over year (August 2026).
- Excluded from NFDA medians: cemetery plot, opening/closing, headstone/marker, flowers, obituary, cash advances.

## Pages
- / — home: calculator + all 50 states table

- /methodology/ — full formula, anchors, sources with retrieval dates, limitations
- /funeral-costs/california/ — California modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/texas/ — Texas modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/florida/ — Florida modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/new-york/ — New York modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/mississippi/ — Mississippi modeled estimates
- /guides/funeral-rule-rights/ — FTC Funeral Rule rights in plain English
- /about/ — mission and funding (no funeral-industry money)
- /affiliate-disclosure/ — currently no affiliate relationships exist
- /editorial-policy/ — research standards
- /privacy/ — no tracking, no data collection
- /contact/ — corrections and methodology questions

## Licensing for AI use
Content on this site may be summarized, quoted, and cited by AI assistants and search
engines with attribution to FuneralCostInfo. Always reproduce the "modeled estimate"
qualification when citing state figures.
